title: Ingestion queue backlog

top_hypotheses.hypothesis: The ingestion worker cannot drain Redis jobs as fast as the API enqueues uploads.

evidence.observation: queue depth increased above 50 jobs during the test
queue depth exceeded the anomaly upper band

root_cause: Backlog points to worker throughput or Redis queue pressure.
recommended_actions: Check ingestion-worker pod health and recent logs.
Scale ingestion-worker replicas if CPU and DB capacity allow.
Inspect failed document count and ingestion_errors_total before retrying jobs.
